factions.name: BarrowMoor Kingdoms
factions.description: The dwindling remnants of BarrowMoor hold their lineage with steel and might.

factions.name: Willow Enclave
factions.description: Dense forests can be found all across AldMarke, watchful eyes and careful steps ensure the woods stay unbothered.

factions.name: Red Banner
factions.description: Though some of their denizens may be considered 'lesser' the ragtag factions of the Red Banner would have you

classes.name: Warrior
classes.description: A vanguard who fights on the front lines. Prioritizes heavy armor and heavy weaponry to hold the line for their comrades.
classes.signature_ability: When a warrior drops to zero body, they cling to the veil and become unwavering. Whenever a warrior in this state activates, or takes a wound, make a morale check. If the check is successful, the warrior is not removed from the game. For every wound received while in this state, -3 to the warrior's morale saves.

classes.name: Rogue
classes.description: Stalking ruins and woods, rogues lie in wait for the opportunity to kill without a trace.
classes.signature_ability:
A Rogue may make a bonus HIDE action if  they are within 1" of a piece of a terrain and not within line of sight of any enemy unit. a Rogue may not be the target of an attack unless a unit within 6" makes a successful DC15 mind check. If a Rogue begins its activation hidden, its attacks have advantage. 

While hidden the rogue gains the following reaction:  Sneak Attack: while hidden if an enemy ends it's movement within 6" of the rogue, the rogue may immediately charge and attack that unit with advantage.

classes.name: Wizard
classes.signature_ability:
Choose a school of magic to be your focus gain the following in the chosen school
- Reduce the spell slot level of a spell. (lvl 3 spell would only take 2 slots)
- Choose a spell from that school as your signature spell. Reduce its mana cost by 1.
- You may craft scrolls of that chosen school at half the cost. (in a one off skirmish game, you may add 1 of these to your parties inventory)

classes.name: Ranger
classes.description: Scouts and scavengers, once a ranger has marked their prey, the only thing left is time.
classes.signature_ability: Predator: At the beginning of a turn, name a unit on the battlefield. This is the rangers prey. All attacks against the chosen unit have advantage while the Ranger has visibility of the chosen unit. If a unit marked as prey is taken out, they grant Valor and Veil.

classes.name: Bard
classes.description: Feasting on the emotions of others, Bards cast powerful magics capable of empowering even the most demoralized allies.
classes.signature_ability:
as a free action, roll a D4-D20
- Crits: For every crit, you may add 1 Valor.
- d20 crit: heal 1 wound from a friendly unit within 6"
- Doubles: a Target unit within 6" may move 3"
- Triple: All enemy units within 12" are stunned.
- Quad: All enemy units within 12" take 1D4 damage and make a morale check

classes.name: Berzerker
classes.signature_ability:
The Berzerker takes 1 wound and creates 2 Veil, and enters rage until the end of their activation. While in rage you gain the following:
- When you make a melee attack action, you may make another
- You may re-roll wound rolls
- You cannot be fatigued.

classes.name: Cleric
classes.description: "Keep screaming the wound is almost shut!"
classes.signature_ability: At the beginning of the game, choose a point on the battlefield, everything within 4" of this area is your sanctuary. Units inside your sanctuary gain Aegis 15+.

classes.name: Warlock
classes.description: Most of the denizens would rather avoid areas strong in veil ether, Warlocks however, seek it out.
classes.signature_ability:
The warlocks manifests their pain in various ways, summoning apparitions to aid them in battle
- Pact Materna: A healing sprite
- Pact Fraterna: A brawling tank
- Pact Apprenta: A minion spellcaster

guilds.name: Cult of the Five Eyes
guilds.ability_description: Members of the Cult of the Five Eyes are trained in the oldest techniques of stealth and assassination. They gain the Five Eyes feat, allowing them to add the POISON keyword to their attacks.

guilds.name: Church of the Lost King
guilds.ability_description: The Lost King may have gone mad, but his study of the veil allowed him to strike any who opposed, followers of this Guild gain the SMITE feat.

guilds.name: College of Constellation
guilds.ability_description: Members of the College of Constellation may cast Blink and Teleport as a BONUS action.

guilds.name: Pact of the Wild Roots
guilds.ability_description: Guild members gain access to the "Healing Roots" feat.

guilds.name: Wyrm Hunters Guild
guilds.ability_description: Wyrm hunters train to keep pace with the mighty beasts of the willow

guilds.name: Marauders Guild
guilds.ability_description: Mauraders are adept at group tactics and gain access to the pack leader feat.

guilds.name: Way of the forbidden past
guilds.ability_description: As a bonus action this unit may deal 2 wounds to a friendly unit within 6" Gain 1 Veil and 1 temporary Mana.

guilds.name: Sailors Guild
guilds.ability_description: Members of the sailor's guild sport superior sea legs. Gain advantage on jump and climb actions and ignore movement penalties for difficult terrain. Sailors guild members are also a merry crew, gain +1 to your spirit.

guilds.name: Black Spire Watchers
guilds.ability_description: Black Spire members are adept at long ranged engagements. Add +6" to the range characteristic of spells and attacks from members.

guilds.name: Order of the Barrows
guilds.ability_description: Anytime an order of the barrows unit is eliminated, any unit within 6" may make one action.

guilds.name: Cult of Bog
guilds.ability_description: Enemy units within 6" of cult of bog units are fatigued.

This weapons damage is reduced by 2 for every unit beyond the first it hits, and for every piece of intervening terrain. (ex: A piece of terrain is in between the caster and two units. the first unit suffers 1D10 damage, the other 1D8.)

spells.name: CounterSpell
spells.description: If the caster is within 6" or is the target of a cast action, bonus action, or reaction,  They may make a DC13+Mind check and negate the spell.

spells.name: Flick

spells.name: Misty Veil

spells.description: The caster summons a ghostly familiar within 3" of them. The familiar has 10 Haste, 6" Move, D6 Armor and attack, and 2 Body, Mind, And Spirit.

spells.name: Wall
spells.description: Summon a 1x3 wall 3" tall that cannot be traversed or seen through, even by other magical affects.

spells.description: Choose a point on the battlefield. A cloud of Poison gas emanates 6" from that point on the battlefield. Units in the cloud are fatigued, and units who begin their activation in the poison cloud must make a DC12+Body save or recieve 1 wound and be fatigued.

spells.name: Guiding Light
spells.description: Choose a point on the battlefield. A guiding light erupts from the center of that point out 6". All attacks against units wholly within this area have advantage. Units inside the area  cannot target units outside of it.

spells.name: Eldritch Apparition
spells.description: Summon a terrifying visage in front of  a creature you can see within 12". They must immediately make a morale check.

spells.name: Mind Shatter
spells.description: Target creature with a display of lights sounds and senses. Roll 1D10, if the result is higher than the targets Mind stat, they take 1 wound.

spells.name: Conjure Abomination
spells.description: Choose a point on the battlefield. The area within 6" of this point is consumed by darkness. Eldritch tentacles lash out for 1D10+1D6 damage and stun creatures who begin or end their movement in the area.

spells.name: Blink
spells.description: Caster chooses a point visible to them up to 6" away. Remove them from the battlefield and re-deploy them at the chosen point.

spells.name: Acidic Armor
spells.description: Choose a target creature and slowly turn their armor to acid. Roll a D10 and add +1 for every armor point above 6. If this beats their armor save they take a wound.

spells.name: Mudify
spells.description: When the caster becomes the target of a charge, they may fuse the ground with water in front of them.  Charging unit must treat the entirety of the charge as if it were over difficult terrain.

spells.name: Teleport
spells.description: Caster may choose a point within 12". Target unit within 2" of caster may be removed from the battlefield, and re-deployed at that point.

spells.name: Alter Self
spells.description: When made the target of an attack. Caster may attempt to disguise themselves as an ally of the attacker. Attacker must pass a DC15 mind check or they remain tricked and must choose a new target.

spells.name: Gaseous Form
spells.description: Target becomes a gaseous cloud and may move freely through terrain until the finish a move action.

spells.description: Target a piece of terrain that is no larger than 6"x6" the piece of terrain catches fire with arcane flames. Any unit within 1" of the terrain must immediately take environmental+1d6 damage.

spells.description: Target a piece of terrain no larger than 3"x3". Grant it sentience. it gains the stat block of a familiar.

hirelings.abilities: The pact fraterna may grapple an enemy unit it is in combat with. The unit must make a Dc12+body check or be stunned. The grappled unit may repeat this check when they activate.

customAbilities.description: The pact fraterna may grapple an enemy unit it is in combat with. The unit must make a Dc12+body check or be stunned. The grappled unit may repeat this check when they activate.

hirelings.name: Pact Apprenta
hirelings.abilities: Spells cast by the warlock may be channeled through the apprenta minion. May use the apprenta model for line of sight and targeting as if the apprenta was casting the spell.

customAbilities.description: Spells cast by the warlock may be channeled through the apprenta minion. May use the apprenta model for line of sight and targeting as if the apprenta was casting the spell.

hirelings.name: Gnoll Archer
hirelings.abilities: hail of arrows(2 Valor): Every friendly non-elite unit within 3" may make a free shoot action at the target of this unit.

customAbilities.name: hail of arrows(2 Valor)
customAbilities.description: Every friendly non-elite unit within 3" may make a free shoot action at the target of this unit.

customFeats.name: Overcharge
customFeats.description: Before making a shoot action this unit may overcharge their weapon to add the Arcane keyword.
